name: Retroid Pocket 5

models.name: Retroid Pocket 5
models.notes: Single model; Snapdragon 865, Android/Linux dual boot

summary: GoRetroid's Snapdragon 865-based Android handheld with Linux dual-boot capability; KNULLI and ROCKNIX both publish builds. Boots KNULLI from SD card by holding Volume Up at power-on; returns to Android on next boot without SD card.

variants.notes: Snapdragon 865 SoC. Android/Linux dual boot — boots KNULLI from SD card by holding Volume Up at power-on, returns to Android when booted normally. KNULLI interface: Emulation Station. ROCKNIX (SM8250 build) is installed via an SD card image plus the ROCKNIX ABL.

homebrew.name: KNULLI
homebrew.firmware: Prepared SD card image; boots by holding Volume Up at power-on.
homebrew.summary: Batocera-based retro gaming OS for the Retroid Pocket 5. Dual-boot with Android — boot KNULLI from SD card with Volume Up held, return to Android by removing the card.

compatibility.note: The Retroid Pocket 5 boots both Android and Linux. KNULLI release 20260511 lists it under 'Early releases' (builds provided as is; most features working, work still to be done). KNULLI is accessed by shutting down, inserting a prepared SD card, and holding Volume Up at power-on.

requirements: A good-quality SD card (SanDisk, Lexar, etc.).
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer (Rufus, balenaEtcher or dd).
warnings: Hold Volume Up at power-on to boot KNULLI; remove the SD card and boot normally to return to Android.

homebrew.name: ROCKNIX
homebrew.firmware: SD card image (SM8250 build); ROCKNIX ABL boot-mode switch.
homebrew.summary: Mainline-Linux retro gaming OS (Sway + Emulation Station) for the Retroid Pocket 5. Image the SM8250 build to an SD card, flash the ROCKNIX ABL from Android, then switch boot mode to Linux in the ABL.

compatibility.note: ROCKNIX lists the Retroid Pocket 5 (Qualcomm SD865 SM8250) with a mainline Linux kernel and Freedreno/Turnip graphics. The device page states no stability or status rating. Installation: image the SM8250 build to an SD card, boot Android and copy rocknix_abl to internal storage, run backup_abl.sh then flash_abl.sh via Settings -> Handheld Settings -> Advanced -> Run Script as Root, restart holding Vol-, set the device model, switch boot mode to 'Linux' and Start. In the ABL, 'Set device model' offers Retroid Pocket 5 or Retroid Pocket 5 Visionox as appropriate. Dual screen addon: only through manual configuration.

requirements: A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer (Rufus, Raspberry Pi Imager or dd).
Android boot with the Run Script as Root option (Settings -> Handheld Settings -> Advanced) to flash the ROCKNIX ABL; the page does not mention a bootloader unlock.
warnings: Flashing the ROCKNIX ABL replaces the device's ABL; run backup_abl.sh first, as the page instructs.
installtointernal (optional) resets Android userdata, like a factory reset.
